features.name: One-tool phone detection Agent
features.description: An Ollama-backed Agent exposes only detect(text) and returns has_phone/count for mainland China mobile numbers.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 14 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Confidence-gated detection cascade
features.description: Per content kind, high-precision patterns run first, a recall tier flags number-shaped runs tier 0 cannot read, and an optional adjudicating tier receives only the still-ambiguous spans. No tier may weaken a settled fact or speak about a span it was not handed.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 169 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Declarative policy engine
features.description: A versioned, diffable YAML rule set resolves label x confidence x purpose x destination x caller role into allow/mask/hash/tokenize/block/review, first match wins, fail-closed, with a printable decision path and test vectors carried in the file itself.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 169 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Disposition routing and reversibility
features.description: Verdicts dispatch to one handler per action: masking and salted hashing are one-way, tokenisation is reversible through a vault, and whether a response is restored is a policy switch.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 169 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).

features.name: Privilege separation and output review
features.description: The agent that reads untrusted content returns only facts and holds no authority; the agent that decides never opens the envelope. A reviewer re-checks released output for surviving values and for over-redaction.
features.evidence: ./init.sh: Ruff clean, format clean, 169 focused tests passed, compileall passed (2026-08-30).
